headlines.title: Why most ads are terrible: Former Microsoft CSO
headlines.summary: Stagwell CEO, former Microsoft Chief Strategy Officer, and White House pollster Mark Penn sits down with Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi to break down why most modern digital ads fail, and how AI is completely rewriting the rules of what you buy.

headlines.title: Starbucks to Close Select North America Coffeehouses, Cuts Store Outlook
headlines.summary: Starbucks Corp shares are up slightly Friday morning. The company is in focus after announcing plans to close underperforming coffeehouses in North America.

headlines.title: Did your favorite local Starbucks just close? These 36 SoCal locations are likely shuttered
headlines.summary: Starbucks said it would close 250 locations in North America as the chain battles increased competition. Thirty-six of those locations appear to be in Southern California.

headlines.title: Starbucks rival cafe chain has closed 130 locations
headlines.summary: People might still buy an indulgent coffee, but they’re cutting back elsewhere.

headlines.title: Starbucks Will Close 250 Stores. His $20,000 401(k) Loan Won’t Count Against Social Security’s Earnings Test, but It Could Make More of His Benefit Taxable
headlines.summary: When Starbucks closes his store, a 64-year-old barista's unpaid 401(k) loan could quietly pull thousands of dollars in Social Security benefits into taxable income, and a deadline most people miss determines whether any of it is avoidable.

description: Starbucks Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, operates as a roaster, marketer, and retailer of coffee internationally. The company operates through three segments: North America, International, and Channel Development. Its stores offer coffee, tea, and other beverages, roasted whole beans and ground coffees, complementary food, packaged coffees, single-serve products, and ready-to-drink beverages; and various food products, such as pastries, breakfast sandwiches, and lunch items. The company also licenses its trademarks through licensed stores, and grocery and foodservice accounts. The company offers its products under the Starbucks Coffee, Teavana, Seattle's Best Coffee, Ethos, and Starbucks Reserve brands. Starbucks Corporation was founded in 1971 and is based in Seattle, Washington.
